repository.scope: Single-player Unity WebGL first playable; one SignalGarden scene; desktop Chrome/Edge target; no multiplayer, network, progression, or production promotion.

qualificationUpdates.reason: The prior visual-polish candidate rendered correctly, but the owner qualification packet must be rerun after this terrain and trail refinement. The new candidate calms the island center and adds restrained stepping-stone variation without changing gameplay, route rules, controls, or accessibility state transitions.

localRenderSmoke.method: Local nested preview on the visual-audit build rendered the refined diorama and completed a valid source-to-receiver drag.
localRenderSmoke.classification: VISUAL_SMOKE_ONLY; does not satisfy owner FPS, TTI, focus, accessibility, or human gates.

desktopChromeForeground.reason: Replacement candidate requires a fresh independently observed foreground Chrome run after the WebGL rendering fix.

desktopEdgeForeground.reason: Replacement candidate requires a fresh independently observed foreground Edge run after the WebGL rendering fix.

localColdTimeToInteractive.reason: Replacement candidate requires fresh cold-cache timing after the WebGL rendering fix.

browserWorkingSet.reason: Replacement candidate has not been measured with an operating-system process view.

physicalFocusLoss.reason: Replacement candidate requires a real browser focus interruption.

screenReader.reason: Replacement candidate requires external screen-reader operation.

humanBenchmark.reason: Five fresh-player sessions must be run against the replacement candidate.
